title: Point inverse of short Weierstrass curve
summary: The negative point of P=(x,y) on the prime field is (x,−y mod p), and the point at infinity is the additive identity element.
applies: Nonsingular short Weierstrass curves over primes; characteristic > 3
detail: For example, when p=17 and y=1, the ordinate of the negative point is 16. Adding P and −P gives us the point at infinity.
boundary: When y=0, the non-infinity point can be equal to its own negative point, and the doubled point is the infinity point. Different curve models have different coordinate formulas.
relevance: When there are two candidates for processing the ordinate, identify their relationship in the point group.
